description: Fine-tuning small language models with LoRA/QLoRA

hooks.command: filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then ruff format "$filepath" 2>/dev/null && ruff check --fix --quiet "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.(env|env\.local|env\.production|env\.staging)$|credentials\.json$|secrets\.ya?ml$|\.pem$|\.key$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive files (.env, credentials, keys). Manage these manually.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
